name: bash_set_e_block
title: 'set +e' needed at block start in CI scripts with continue-on-error
symptom: A CI step dies mid-script even though the next command should have run
cause: GitHub Actions runs with bash -e (exit on error). A command without '||' kills the step
fix: Use 'set +e' at the start of a protected block, or ensure every fallible command uses '||'
mal_code: aws rds describe-db-instances  # fails → step dies
good_code:
set +e
aws rds describe-db-instances 2>/dev/null
echo 'continues always'
